source_commit_role: Last behavior-changing commit. It contains only the development-only Stage-A/Stage-B prototype and leaves v1 execution defaults unchanged.
execution_commit_policy: A later commit may implement only this frozen v2 contract. Any change to generators, candidates, sampling, utility, statistics, timeouts, split semantics, or selection requires a new versioned instance.

scope.treatment: E_FULL_GEOMETRY with a fixed support-margin gate
scope.control: E_FULL_GEOMETRY with the override gate disabled
out_of_scope: B_INCOHERENT, C_THETA_ZERO, and D_U1_PHASE score implementations
domains outside the four frozen families

environment.numeric_determinism_rule: Every record binds generator, outcome, policy, sampler, and branch random-stream seeds. Any environment deviation is a new instance.

domain_manifest.generator_semantics: The four E0-G1-v1 generators at source_commit, exposed only through new v2 split namespaces.
domain_manifest.family_scale_weighting: Each of 12 family-scale cells has equal weight.

exploration.role: Historical development evidence only; may motivate this preregistration but may not select or confirm a policy.

protected_holdout.access_condition: Open only after the frozen selected policy passes v2 verification without retuning.

stage_b_closed_loop.primary_utility: Mean success_adjusted_efficiency over the 20 evaluation episodes.
stage_b_closed_loop.infrastructure_failure: Invalid cell; retain it and rerun the whole candidate-family-scale cell with identical seeds.

stage_a_paired_evidence.sampling_frame: Executed overrides in evaluation episodes of that candidate's complete Stage-B trace.
stage_a_paired_evidence.sample_priority: Ascending SHA-256 of the frozen sampler salt and decision identity; choose the first four unique priorities.
stage_a_paired_evidence.fewer_than_cap_rule: Sample every executed override if a replicate has fewer than four.
stage_a_paired_evidence.zero_override_rule: Emit an empty, valid sampling manifest; activation support fails if the frozen minimum is not met.
stage_a_paired_evidence.post_first_action_policy: The disabled-gate E_FULL_GEOMETRY control from the branched state.
stage_a_paired_evidence.rollout_horizon: Until terminal state or the original episode's remaining 4 * actual_node_count interaction budget is exhausted.
stage_a_paired_evidence.branch_utility: success_adjusted_efficiency in [0,1], using the G1-v1 oracle-cost definition

timeouts.infrastructure_retry: Whole cell, identical inputs, immutable attempt artifacts, highest attempt only, no fallback to earlier attempts.

minimum_activation_support.applies_to: Each non-disabled candidate on calibration and again to the selected active policy on verification.

statistics.stage_b_interval: One-sided percentile paired stratified cluster bootstrap.
statistics.stage_a_harm_interval: One-sided percentile stratified cluster bootstrap of the conditional harmful fraction over sampled executed overrides; resample seed replicates and retain each replicate's complete sample cluster.
statistics.stage_a_zero_sample_replicates: Excluded from the conditional harm denominator but included in activation-support accounting.
statistics.stage_a_severe_harm_rule: Zero-tolerance observed sentinel, not a population-rate estimate.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni at family-wise alpha 0.05 across all non-disabled candidates and every inferential eligibility constraint within a split.

selection_rule.stage_a_role: Safety and support eligibility filter only.
eligible_if: complete infrastructure-valid Stage A and Stage B matrices
all Stage-A harm, severe-harm, unresolved, and sample-support constraints pass
all Stage-B benefit, family non-inferiority, activation, algorithm-timeout, and path-cap constraints pass
selection_rule.optimization: Largest pooled equal-cell-weight Stage-B primary effect among eligible non-disabled candidates.
selection_rule.tie_breaker: Among eligible candidates within 0.005 primary-effect units of the best point estimate, choose the largest min_support_margin; remaining exact ties sort by policy_id.

missingness_and_retry.stage_b_algorithm_timeout: Valid parent outcome scored 0.0 and candidate fails the zero-timeout eligibility constraint.
missingness_and_retry.stage_a_branch_timeout: Valid unresolved safety outcome; never imputed and candidate is ineligible.
missingness_and_retry.stage_a_trace_mismatch: Infrastructure-invalid cell; retain and rerun whole cell.
missingness_and_retry.runner_or_upload_failure: Infrastructure-invalid cell; retain and rerun whole cell.
missingness_and_retry.partial_latest_attempt: Invalid; no fallback to an earlier attempt.

verification_rule.failure_action: Select gate_disabled and do not open protected_holdout.
verification_rule.pass_action: Freeze verification artifact and permit one protected-holdout execution.

implementation_prerequisites: Implement new v2 split namespaces without weakening any earlier holdout guard.
Implement complete branch-free Stage-B traces and parent-only timeouts.
Implement the deterministic hash-priority Stage-A sampler.
Implement exact Stage-A parent replay, trace matching, branch timeouts, and unresolved statuses.
Implement split-aware atomic artifacts, immutable retries, and complete-matrix consolidation.
Implement the frozen joint Stage-A/Stage-B statistics and selection report.
Validate a no-outcome dry-run before requesting authorization.
forbidden_before_execution: Generating a calibration authorization before implementation and no-outcome dry-run review.
Changing candidates or sampling after any v2 calibration outcome.
Reusing observed v1 calibration seeds 2000 through 2019.
Repurposing reserved v1 verification or holdout seeds.
Instantiating v2 calibration, verification, or protected-holdout domains during implementation.
Charging Stage-A work to Stage-B parent timing.
Changing a framework default from this preregistration alone.
